title: Dakota
description: Documented public UQ toolkit (Sandia National Laboratories (open source)) for the Uncertainty Quantification Workbench capability area.
body:
Dakota is a documented UQ toolkit from Sandia National Laboratories (open source). Sandia's flagship toolkit for uncertainty quantification, optimization, and sensitivity analysis of expensive simulation models.

How it works: It works by sampling thousands of Gaussian input draws, pushing each through the model, and summarizing the output distribution with mean, standard deviation, and a 95th percentile.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
